fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: After learning this program, students can know more about how to identify and analyze worldwide marketing opportunities, and examine product, pricing, distribution and promotion strategies. International Marketing examines the impact of economic, cultural, political, legal and other environmental influences on international marketing. Within this context, the focus is on how to identify and analyze worldwide marketing opportunities, and examine product, pricing, distribution and promotion strategies. ​ 2. Specialization courses Editor Notes: Students are required to accomplish all compulsory specialization courses of their own majors. Besides, they need to select 7 more specialization courses from other majors. International Marketing Management (compulsory) Consumer Behavior (compulsory) Brand Management (compulsory) Marketing Research Methods (compulsory) International Business Entrepreneurship International Business Negotiation Strategic Management Internation Investment Analysis International Finance M&A and Investment Banking Financial Markets and Institutions Chinese Business Environment Chinese Culture & Business Etiquette China Business Law Doing Business in China 3. Internship and Career Editor Notes: Students of this program will have chances of do internships in multinational companies and organizations in China. Opportunities in multinational companies and organizations in China. 4. Introduction of Beijing Foreign Studies University-International Business School(BFSUIBS) Editor Notes: IBS is one of the youngest and most vigorous schools of Beijing Foreign Studies University (BFSU). International Business School (IBS) is one of the youngest and most dynamic schools at Beijing Foreign Studies University (BFSU) and also the largest in terms of student number. Founded in 2001, IBS currently has more than 1500 students including undergraduates, postgraduates, international students, and overseas foundation programs students. IBS aims to provide future business elites from all over the world with the core of Chinese and world civilizations, pass on common values of all humanity, probe business knowledge both known and unknown, and help its students discover their own unique characters and values of life. Learn More>> 5. Campus Life Editor Notes: Colorful activities on campus and off campus will be provided by BFSUIBS. BFSU won the awards at the 2020 "100 Reasons to Love Beijing" Short Video Contest ​​ BFSUers Preform at Asian Cultural Carnival ​​​

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Custody Release Form Correctly and completely filled-in. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Copy of Guardian’s Photo Page of Passport (Who Signed on the Custody Release Form) 3. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 4. Copy of photo page of passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 5. Senior High school graduate certificate or A Level Certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 6. Senior high school academic transcript or A level transcripts Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. 7. Proof of English Proficiency required for Non-native English speakers TOEFL, IELTS or TOEIC * 8. Personal Statement Written in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. 2 Letters of Recommendation Required to be filled by the school teachers for applicants currently studying at school. You can download a template or sample from here . 10. Study certificate For applicants currently studying in a university in China. 11. School transfer certificate or School withdrawal certificate For applicants currently studying for degrees in a university in China. 12. Recommendation letter and academic transcript from your current university For applicants currently studying in a university in China. * 13. Affirmative Statement You can download a template or sample from here . * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
